scope: H2 allocation-control component only. Software-backed page storage, primitive/state caching, bin append/replay, restart/spill integration and two independent tile engines remain open. TileDrawBinner still has its eight-record chunk capacity.

contract.page_bytes: Elaboration capacity: power of two,64..65536. MobileGpuConfig.binPageBytes defaults to4096. External backing pages are excluded from the368KiB proposed on-chip array total.
contract.binding: Version1 snapshots context/pass/generation,32-bit base,33-bit exclusive limit and page-size log2. Base/limit must be aligned, base<=limit<=4GiB; empty arenas are legal and exhaust on first allocation. Unsupported versions/page sizes or malformed bounds fail before allocation.
contract.allocation: Monotonic disjoint full pages. Reply carries immutable identity, tile, opaque token, address and ordinal. Successful allocations alone advance the address/counter. Full4GiB exclusive bound and terminal nextAddress are retained without32-bit wrap.
contract.exhaustion: The first exhausted request returns its original tile/token and zero address with explicit exhausted status. Admission then stops until end/cancel. The caller retains this uncommitted primitive as its restart point. This component does not implement primitive commit or retries.
contract.ownership: No reuse/rebind until all offered allocation replies are accepted and completion retires. End/cancel stops admission; an offered reply remains stable under backpressure, including cancellation. The caller must separately drain page memory users before ending/recycling its arena.
contract.progress: One allocation/reply per cycle with a ready consumer after admission; a stalled consumer backpressures the allocator. Invalid descriptors and cancellation produce tagged held completions.
contract.events: Per-cycle successful/failed allocation events; sticky exhaustion and binding descriptor retained until a new binding. Reset discards local replies, not external memory ownership.

coverage: Four-page bounds with a fifth exhausted request and exact restart token; adversarial reply stalls and no success/failure counter pulses while stalled.
Six malformed views, empty view, stable context/pass/generation and held completion.
Last page ending exactly at4GiB, exhaustion without wrapping, cancellation with offered reply, generation rebinding.
Sixty-four consecutive allocation replies at one/cycle.
End with a pending reply blocks new allocation and delays completion; reset discards a pending reply.
Proposed storage total remains368KiB; invalid bin-page sizes rejected.
functional.proof_limit: Numeric/protocol RTL simulation and arithmetic bounds reasoning; not a universal temporal formal proof.

qualification.scope: All reported synthesis setup paths, including I/O

mapping.scope: Synthesis mapping report; omitted operators and undriven logic fail qualification

synthesis.scope: Standalone combinational/control mapping and synthesis setup screen, including I/O. No routed hold or whole-GPU clock/area/energy qualification.

integration_remaining: Connect a bounded page writer with immutable primitive/state references, memory faults/ack drain and exact committed restart position; replace eight-record bin replay; preserve per-tile order and page ownership through two independent engines, spill, restart and cancellation.
